Author: ceeprus
Name: Turkish Chat Support
Punchline: Turkish letters the game font lacks (ğ Ğ ş ı İ) become g G s i I, so chat shows letters instead of =.
Description: FFXIV's font has no ğ, Ğ, ş, ı or İ, so every player sees = in their place. This plugin swaps them for g, G, s, i and I in what you type and send from the chat box, pasted text included, so anyone can read your messages without a plugin. It also fixes messages and speech bubbles from Turkish players who don't use it, on your screen. Dotless ı can become i or Greek ι in the settings.
